fullTextZH: 周杰伦觉得方文山写的歌词不怎么样，
fullTextEN: Jay Chou thinks the lyrics written by Vincent Fang are not that great,
they're just not particularly good,

fullTextZH: 方文山觉得周杰伦写的歌不好听，
fullTextEN: Vincent Fang thinks the songs written by Jay Chou don't sound good,

fullTextZH: 所以一开始的时候他们两个人都不喜欢
fullTextEN: so at the beginning, neither of them liked
didn't like each other.
Hello,
I am Sika from Taiwan,

fullTextZH: 欢迎回到周杰伦的故事。
fullTextEN: welcome back to the story of Jay Chou.

fullTextZH: 今天我想聊聊周杰伦和他的同事的故事。
fullTextEN: Today I want to talk about the story of Jay Chou and his colleague.

fullTextZH: 同事就是一起工作的人，
fullTextEN: A colleague is someone you work with,

fullTextZH: 周杰伦有一位特别的同事，
fullTextEN: Jay Chou has a special colleague,

fullTextZH: 他们一起工作了 23 年，
fullTextEN: they have worked together for 23 years,

fullTextZH: 他们一起做了快 100 首的歌，
fullTextEN: they have made almost 100 songs together,

fullTextZH: 这个同事的名字叫做方文山。
fullTextEN: this colleague's name is Vincent Fang.

fullTextZH: 那他们是怎么认识的呢？
fullTextEN: So how did they meet?

fullTextZH: 周杰伦还不是偶像之前，
fullTextEN: Before Jay Chou became an idol,
he worked at a record company,

fullTextZH: 方文山也在那间唱片公司工作，
fullTextEN: Vincent Fang also worked at that record company,

fullTextZH: 所以他们是在公司认识的。
fullTextEN: so they met at the company.

fullTextZH: 那个时候他们两个人都不有名，
fullTextEN: At that time, neither of them were famous,
Their work is not going well,
All is not good,

fullTextZH: 没有人想唱周杰伦写的歌，
fullTextEN: No one wants to sing the songs written by Jay Chou,

fullTextZH: 也没有人想买方文山写的歌词。
fullTextEN: Nor does anyone want to buy the lyrics written by Vincent Fang.

fullTextZH: 周杰伦为了工作常常在公司过夜，
fullTextEN: Jay Chou often stays overnight at the company for work,
He just doesn't go home after work,
He sleeps at the company.
What about Vincent Fang?
He doesn't have money to rent a house,
so he also sleeps at the company.

fullTextZH: 你觉得因为这样他们两个人变成好朋友吗？
fullTextEN: Do you think they became good friends because of this?
No,

fullTextZH: 一开始他们两个人都不喜欢
fullTextEN: At first, neither of them liked
didn't like each other,

fullTextZH: 周杰伦觉得方文山写的歌词不怎么样，
fullTextEN: Jay Chou thought the lyrics written by Vincent Fang were not that great,
just not particularly good,

fullTextZH: 方文山觉得周杰伦写的歌不好听，
fullTextEN: Vincent Fang thought the songs written by Jay Chou didn't sound good,

fullTextZH: 所以一开始的时候他们两个人都不喜欢
fullTextEN: so at first, neither of them liked
didn't like each other.

fullTextZH: 后来他们的老板要周杰伦和方文山一起写歌，
fullTextEN: Later, their boss wanted Jay Chou and Vincent Fang to write songs together,
Jay Chou composes music,
Vincent Fang writes lyrics,

fullTextZH: 他们一起工作的时间长了，
fullTextEN: They have worked together for a long time,
so they are getting more familiar with each other,

fullTextZH: 越来越知道对方是怎么样的人，
fullTextEN: increasingly knowing what kind of person the other is,
and also discovering each other's strengths.

fullTextZH: 周杰伦发现方文山写的歌词很特别，
fullTextEN: Jay Chou found that Vincent Fang's lyrics are very special,
different from what others write,

fullTextZH: 方文山也发现周杰伦真的很有音乐才华，
fullTextEN: Vincent Fang also found that Jay Chou is truly musically talented,

fullTextZH: 他们一起做了很多的歌，
fullTextEN: they made many songs together,
these songs are all very popular,
very well-received,

fullTextZH: 周杰伦的歌加上方文山写的歌词，特别的好听，
fullTextEN: Jay Chou's songs combined with Vincent Fang's lyrics are especially pleasant to listen to,
especially interesting.

fullTextZH: 方文山因为帮周杰伦写歌词也变得越来越有名，
fullTextEN: Vincent Fang became more famous because he helped Jay Chou write lyrics,

fullTextZH: 很多明星都想要方文山帮他们写歌词，
fullTextEN: many celebrities want Vincent Fang to write lyrics for them,

fullTextZH: 可是他们一起工作的时候也常常拌嘴，
fullTextEN: but when they work together, they often bicker,
bicker,
which means small arguments,
not very serious,
After arguing, they are still good friends.

fullTextZH: 例如有一次周杰伦在唱歌的时候，
fullTextEN: For example, once when Jay Chou was singing,
he forgot the lyrics,
he said to Vincent Fang,

fullTextZH: 因为你写的歌词太难了，
fullTextEN: because the lyrics you wrote are too difficult,
I can't remember them.
Vincent Fang said to Jay Chou,
you don't articulate clearly,
your pronunciation is unclear,
and you didn't sing my lyrics well.

fullTextZH: 周杰伦也常常说，方文山写歌词写得太慢了。
fullTextEN: Jay Chou often says that Vincent Fang writes lyrics too slowly.

fullTextZH: 有一次周杰伦要方文山帮他写歌词，
fullTextEN: Once, Jay Chou asked Vincent Fang to help him write lyrics,
but after a long time,
Vincent Fang still hadn't finished writing.
Jay Chou got anxious,
so he wrote them himself,
and he even wrote in the lyrics:
Vincent,
by the time you finish writing,
I will have already released my next album.
It's okay,

fullTextZH: 慢慢来，这首歌我自己来。
fullTextEN: Take your time, I'll handle this song myself.
One more time,

fullTextZH: 周杰伦在唱歌录音的时候，
fullTextEN: When Jay Chou was recording a song,
He changed the lyrics himself,

fullTextZH: 方文山知道以后非常生气，
fullTextEN: Vincent Fang was very angry after knowing,
Hmph,

fullTextZH: 他对周杰伦说：这首歌的歌词是我写的，
fullTextEN: He said to Jay Chou: The lyrics of this song were written by me,
You can't change them,
Please sing it again.
Jay Chou said: No,
I don't want to re-sing.

fullTextZH: 方文山说：这首歌的钱我不要了，
fullTextEN: Vincent Fang said: I don't want the money for this song,
Please sing it again.

fullTextZH: 结果周杰伦说：不要这首歌的钱我也不要了，
fullTextEN: As a result, Jay Chou said: I don't want the money for this song either,
I just don't want to re-sing.
Vincent Fang had no choice,

fullTextZH: 到现在他还记得这件事情。
fullTextEN: He still remembers this incident to this day.
Look at them bickering,

fullTextZH: 像不像一对结婚很久的老公和老婆呢？
fullTextEN: Don't they seem like a couple married for a long time?

fullTextZH: 你身边有没有这样的同事或朋友呢？
fullTextEN: Do you have colleagues or friends like this around you?
Okay,
In our next episode,
Goodbye,
Bye-bye.
